info.name: BioFlyte Content API (WordPress REST wp/v2) Settings API

description.content:
BioFlyte publishes www.bioflyte.com on WordPress, which exposes the WordPress REST API at https://www.bioflyte.com/wp-json/. The wp/v2 namespace is anonymously readable and returns the company's press releases and news items (the `post` type, 36 published), its Resources library of blog posts and whitepapers (the `resource` custom post type, 6 published), the nine marketing pages, a 374-item media library, taxonomies (`category`, `post_tag`, `resources-category`, `project_category`, `project_tag`, `difl_page_category`) and a site-wide search endpoint, all as JSON with page/per_page pagination and X-WP-Total / X-WP-TotalPages headers.

This document was DERIVED mechanically by API Evangelist from the route-discovery document served at https://www.bioflyte.com/wp-json/ on 2026-08-07 — every path, method and parameter below is taken verbatim from that descriptor. BioFlyte does not publish an OpenAPI definition of its own, and this is not a BioFlyte product API: the BioTOF z200 and MailScreen z200 instruments are operated from a local Windows Command Console and have no public API. This is the content API the CMS exposes. Write operations exist on these routes but require authentication (WordPress Application Passwords over HTTP Basic); settings, themes, plugins and menus return HTTP 401 rest_forbidden anonymously.
